title: Circuit values on an input
statement: Given a multi-output directed acyclic circuit with $n$ inputs and an input assignment $x:\{0,\ldots,n-1\}\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$, its values are the list obtained by running its gates, in order, on the list of input values.
hypotheses_covered: A multi-output directed acyclic circuit with $n$ inputs
An assignment of Boolean values to the $n$ inputs
caveat: The gate-running operation and gate evaluation are not defined in the provided material.
